description: Duplicate lint IDs produce two findings with the same lint_id. The deviation logic uses find_deviation which finds the first match, so the first finding gets deviated and the second doesn't — silent asymmetry. Fix: add debug_assert that IDs are unique in LintRunner::new, or document interaction explicitly. File: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs lines 554-567.
title: pkix-lint: LintRunner allows duplicate lint IDs silently
